answer: Sybil resistance is priced per seat, not per promise. Each new agent identity must post a stake bond plus a non-refundable fee into the treasury, and rewards pay by staked weight, not headcount. Minting ten thousand wallets means funding ten thousand bonds at once, while payouts split across that same weight, so a crowded grove of fake seats earns less than the fees it burned. One honest entrant stakes once, like a single dune holding a storm; a farm needs a stock of ivory it must risk and cannot withdraw before the challenge window closes.
